name: claude-code-mods
description: Four Claude Code terminal mods: pulse, crew, brief and ledger

plugins.name: pulse
plugins.description: Spinner says what Claude is doing, turn line counts the work, status line shows model, effort, context, limits and cost

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Live pane of subagents with avatars; each agent opens in its own pane where you can message it

plugins.name: brief
plugins.description: At a new session, a band shows the project, git state and where the last session here stopped

plugins.name: ledger
plugins.description: Every tool call is one line: status, verb, target, result
